_comment: Shrink-only ratchet for library/tests_verse_consistency.py. Maps a reference to HOW MANY distinct ways its language renders it; a count may fall or a reference may leave, neither may grow. Regenerate with `manage.py audit_verse_consistency --update-baseline --language <lang>` (never by hand, and never by hand-merging a conflict here: take main's copy and re-run) and say in the commit message which renderings you reconciled. That command REFUSES a re-pin that would loosen the ratchet — absorbing a new or widened conflict needs --absorb said out loud, because a silent re-pin is how this file went from 110 conflicts to 322 with CI green throughout.
